span.label: mechanisms
span.term: Kv3-family potassium channel expression gives parvalbumin basket cells their fast-spiking phenotype, which is what allows them to respond with minimal delay and sustain high-frequency firing
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: mechanisms
span.term: interneuron-driven synchronization of principal cell firing produces coincident spikes, which are a more effective trigger of firing downstream and therefore raise transmission efficiency
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: mechanisms
span.term: synchronized principal cell firing facilitates synaptic potentiation and thereby the formation of the potentiated cell ensembles that carry memory traces
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: mechanisms
span.term: O-LM feed-back inhibition blocks plasticity of entorhinal inputs at the theta trough, but pyramidal cells firing ahead of the population in phase precession escape that inhibition and so can potentiate their inputs
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: mechanisms
span.term: feed-forward and feed-back inhibition reduce the number of simultaneously active principal cells, producing sparse representations useful for sensory coding and long-term memory
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: mechanisms
span.term: feedback inhibition sets up winner-take-all competition among principal cells, so that one cell's increased activity suppresses its neighbours
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: critiques → classification schemes that generate cell types from any measurable morphological or physiological difference
span.note: differs in: THE AXIS IS WHETHER THE FEATURE IS CAUSALLY LINKED TO FUNCTION. 'differences in morphological ... or physiological features ... should be used to generate new cell types ONLY IF THESE DIFFERENCES ARE CAUSALLY LINKED [to function].' The critique does not say morphology is the wrong feature - it says a feature earns its place in a classification only through a causal link, which is a condition on the METHOD of classifying, not on the features. Q-446.

span.label: The article argues that interneuron classification is only meaningful when morphological or physiological differences map onto a functional dichotomy, rather than being catalogued for their own sake.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: Interneuron diversity scales with the complexity of the local network, which is why the six-layered neocortex hosts the greatest variety of interneuron types.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: In vivo recordings from anatomically identified cells show each anatomical/neurochemical class has its own characteristic phase relationship to theta, gamma and ripples, supporting functional homogeneity of the anatomical classes.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: Parvalbumin and cholecystokinin basket cells divide the labour: PV cells increase firing during sharp waves while CCK cells do not, reflecting their different feed-forward versus feed-back drives.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: The article advances the proposal that PV basket cell ensembles are the obligatory oscillatory 'clockwork' of cortex, with CCK ensembles superimposed as a modulatory layer.
